name: Ampr
tagline: The charging layer for shared scooter and e-bike fleets.
positioning: Ampr gives fleet operators one platform to meter, dispatch, and bill every charge across depots, curbside docks, and swap stations.

hero.h1: The charging layer for shared micro-mobility fleets.
hero.sub: Ampr meters every kilowatt, schedules chargers around dispatch demand, and reconciles energy costs across every depot and curbside dock — in one operations console.

features.title: Charge-aware dispatch
features.description: Ampr sequences which scooters charge first based on tomorrow's rider demand, so your morning fleet is topped up before the first unlock.

features.title: Per-kWh metering
features.description: Sub-meter every port down to the watt-hour. Split energy cost by depot, by vehicle model, and by shift for finance teams that need it clean.

features.title: Fault detection
features.description: Ampr flags a dead port, a throttled circuit, or a battery that won't accept charge before your field crew ever walks the aisle.

features.title: Utility rate windows
features.description: Shift bulk charging into off-peak rate windows automatically and prove the savings to procurement with an exportable ledger.

features.title: Swap-station sync
features.description: Track battery state of health across swap cabinets and depots so a tired pack never lands back on the street.

features.title: Grid-ready reporting
features.description: One API and one dashboard for utilization, carbon intensity, and demand charges — built for the reports your board already asks for.

testimonials.quote: We were reconciling charging costs across nine depots in spreadsheets. Ampr gave us a per-vehicle energy ledger our finance team actually trusts, and it cut month-end close from four days to one.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: The dispatch-aware charging is the part I didn't know I needed. Our morning availability went up 14% because Ampr charges the right scooters in the right order overnight.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: Ampr caught a failing charge circuit at our Oakland depot a full day before it would have taken out a whole rack. That single alert paid for the platform.
testimonials.name: Marta Kovač
